title: Core: Renderer canvas state (save/restore for groups)
description: Test that the canvas renderer correctly saves/restores context state when rendering layered content. Verify: (1) save() called before applying transform, (2) restore() called after, (3) globalAlpha set correctly for display objects with alpha < 1, (4) the rendering depth stack does not leak state across objects, (5) a hidden (visible=false) object does not emit drawing calls.
